build_GridRoIHead: build a GridRoIHead instance with grid_roi_extractor and grid_head config for object detection
test_random_jitter: test the _random_jitter method to apply random offsets to positive proposal bounding boxes
run_forward_GridRoIHead: run the forward pass of GridRoIHead to get cls_score, bbox_pred, grid_preds, and mask_preds
review_bbox_loss: review the bbox_loss method that computes bounding box and grid head losses with random jitter augmentation
predict_bbox_GridRoIHead: predict bounding boxes using GridRoIHead by running grid head inference on RPN results
